purpose: Resolve the current main-branch Hero and Soldier completion workflows, commands, frozen status artifacts, and safe post-freeze automation hook points before enabling automatic Stage 5 bridge application.

completionWorkflow.name: Hero Stage 6-4 Site Consumer Final Freeze
completionWorkflow.frozenVerificationStep: Verify frozen Stage 6-4 outputs on PR or main

nonAuthoritativeEvidence.reason: PR #157 is still open/draft and is not main-branch authority. Stage 6-1 therefore resolves the existing Stage 6-4 completion workflow as the automation source event.

completionWorkflow.name: Soldier Stage 6-7 Site Admission
completionWorkflow.frozenVerificationStep: Verify frozen Stage 6-7 artifacts on main or PR

nonAuthoritativeEvidence.reason: PR #157 runtime-proved the wrapper but it is still open/draft and the script is not main-branch authority. The historical Stage 4-8 validator is not substituted here.

resolvedDecision.hero: Use Hero Stage 6-4 Site Consumer Final Freeze success as the completion event; attach automatic bridge logic only after its frozen-output verification succeeds.
resolvedDecision.soldier: Use Soldier Stage 6-7 Site Admission success as the completion event; attach automatic bridge logic only after its frozen-output verification succeeds.
resolvedDecision.shared: Do not re-run or replace the materializing completion command from the bridge. Stage 6 automation consumes the already-verified frozen artifact and delegates it through Stage 5 -> Stage 4 -> Stage 3.

nextStep.goal: Add check-only automatic bridge hooks for Hero and Soldier immediately after each completion workflow's frozen-output verification, then prove failure/review blocking before enabling apply.
